svg.title: The workflow that never fired: why a bot's GITHUB_TOKEN commit triggers nothing (and the PAT that changes that)
svg.desc: A CI pipeline: a running 'release' job joined by a severed connector to a greyed-out 'deploy' job marked with an X because it never ran, a key hovering over the broken link, and a loop arrow curving the cascade back on itself. Trace Bloom generative banner for “The workflow that never fired: why a bot's GITHUB_TOKEN commit triggers nothing (and the PAT that changes that)”. A manhattan lattice probed by 2 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 3275256172.
